title: Left flank pain with nausea
source: Adapted from MTS-Dialog (TrainingSet ID 516, GENHX section), CC BY 4.0. Facts are taken only from the source note and dialogue.

profile.context: Attends the clinic alone. No further social details are given in the source record.

facts.text: Has pain in the left flank.
The pain is in the abdomen and across the back.
The pain has been present for the last four to five days.
No blood in the urine and no pain or burning when passing urine.
Another doctor told her she has a stone of about 1.3 cm in the left ureter (the tube from the kidney).
Wants something done about the stone.
